biotools.summary: CRISPRepi is a platform that consolidates extensive sequencing data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, Bisulfite-seq, and ATAC-seq datasets related to CRISPR-based epigenome editing. It allows users to analyze editing outcomes and assess off-target effects.
